opportunity_name: Automated email order processing with stock verification
objective: Automatically detect order emails in Gmail, extract key information, check stock, log in Google Sheets, send confirmation to the customer (or an alert if out of stock or address missing) — without human intervention for standard cases.

trigger.note: Emails that do not match the filter do not trigger the workflow.

steps.name: Extract order fields
steps.implementation: JavaScript Code node (LLM-assisted parsing or structured regex)
steps.logic: Parse the email body to extract: customer_name, customer_email, product(s) ordered, quantity/quantities, shipping_address. Missing values → null.

steps.name: Check if address is present
steps.logic: IF shipping_address == null → branch 'missing address'. ELSE → continue to S03.

steps.name: Send address request to customer
steps.then: Log order in Google Sheets with status='Awaiting address'. END of workflow for this order.

steps.name: Check product stock
steps.lookup: Find the row where column 'Product' = product_name. Read column 'Stock_available'.
steps.note: If multiple products ordered, check stock for each. If any one is out of stock, treat the whole order as out of stock.

steps.name: Check if stock is sufficient
steps.logic: IF stock_available == null OR stock_available < quantity_ordered → branch 'out of stock'. ELSE → continue to S05.

steps.name: Notify Marc and Julien of a stock outage
steps.then: Log order in Google Sheets with status='Out of stock'. END of workflow for this order.
steps.human_checkpoint_note: Marc must contact the customer manually to propose an alternative.

steps.name: Generate order number
steps.logic: Read the last row of the Orders tab in Google Sheets. Extract the last number (format ML-YYYY-NNN). Increment NNN. Build the new number.

email_templates.subject: Your order {{order_number}} is confirmed — La Boîte Artisanale
Your order — missing shipping address
email_templates.body:
Hello {{customer_name}},

We have received your order for {{product}}.

Could you please send us your full shipping address so we can prepare the dispatch?

Thank you,

Marc
La Boîte Artisanale

email_templates.subject: [ALERT] Out of stock — order from {{customer_name}}

error_handling.action: Send a notification to Marc with the original email attached. Google Sheets status = 'Manual review'.
Stop the workflow. Send an alert to Marc. Do not send a confirmation to the customer.

error_handling.scenario: Product not found in the Stock tab
error_handling.action: Treat as out of stock (S04b) — alert Marc and Julien.

confidence_flags.human_checkpoint_details: Out-of-stock situations and unparseable emails require manual action from Marc
confidence_flags.extraction_risk_note: Extraction reliability depends on the actual format of incoming emails. Test on 20 real emails before going live.

deployment.deployment_model: n8n Cloud (Starter plan ~€20/month) OR self-hosted on OVH VPS (~€5/month + Romain's management)
deployment.maintenance: Marc can edit email templates from the n8n interface without touching code. Logic changes (new products, new rules) require Romain.
